title: 8. Porque não devemos discutir e nem polemizar

queries.text: Esther Vilar's "The Manipulated Man" (1972) was written in German; the author translated the line himself. Rendered from his Portuguese.
Translated from the author's Portuguese Bible quotation; the brackets are the author's interpolation. Public-domain KJV: "A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing."
